newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan banks, securities firms up on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Japan banks, securities firms up on short-covering.

text.p: Banks and brokerage issues rose in the Wednesday morning session, activated by short-covering, brokers said.
As of 0030 GMT, securities topped the list of gaining sectors, followed by banks.
Nomura Securities Co Ltd jumped 50 yen to 1,170 and Daiwa Securities Co Ltd climbed 12 yen to 728.
Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd gained 50 yen to 1,890. Sumitomo Bank Ltd rose 70 yen to 1,340.

Brokers said overnight surges on both Wall Street and in Nikkei 225 futures in Chicago spread a feeling of relief in the market. They said the somewhat brighter mood was encourging investors to step up buy-backs of shares which have been under selling pressure.
